title: Switching failure under composed restrictions
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $k$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\text{Fin}(n)$, let $z$ assign a sign to every coordinate outside $J$, and let $\sigma$ assign a coordinate restriction to each coordinate. First impose the fixed signs $z$ outside $J$, leaving the coordinates in $J$ free, and then compose this assignment with $\sigma$. The switching failure indicator of $f$ at threshold $k$ for the resulting assignment equals the indicator for the function on the free coordinates obtained by fixing the outside coordinates to $z$, at threshold $k$, with restrictions given by $\sigma$ on the coordinates in $J$ via their increasing enumeration.
